channelTitle: Most people steep garlic in honey overnight, Grandma June lets hers ferment for weeks
hook: Most people steep garlic in honey overnight and call it done, but the old way was letting it actually ferment.
remedy: As a classic piece of old-fashioned home wisdom, whole peeled garlic cloves left in a light salt brine for a few weeks to naturally ferment, mellowing out the sharp bite, were kept on hand through cold season and eaten a clove at a time.
steps: Peel whole garlic cloves and rinse them
Pack them into a clean jar and cover completely with a light salt-water brine
Cover loosely and let sit at room temperature for two to three weeks, then refrigerate and eat a clove or two a day
caution: If the jar ever smells off or grows mold, throw the whole batch out. Those on blood thinners should check with a doctor before eating garlic regularly.
cta: Have you ever fermented your own garlic, or does honey-steeped sound better to you? Tell Grandma June in the comments.
